meta.title: Changelog
meta.description: New updates and improvements to Perminov Studios. Follow along as we build and improve the platform.

versions.title: Centralized Design System
versions.description: Introduced a unified design token system for easier theming and maintenance across the entire platform.

changes.title: Changed
items: All stylesheets now use centralized design variables

callout.title: Developer Note
callout.message: To change the site theme, you now only need to edit the **Global Design Variables** file. All components will automatically inherit the new values.

versions.title: Code Organization and Documentation
versions.description: Major refactoring to improve code readability, maintainability, and developer experience across the entire codebase.

changes.title: Added
items: Inline code comments throughout all files

changes.title: Page Updates
items: **Login and Sign Up** — Meta descriptions, organized structure

changes.title: Code Quality
items: Added table of contents to all stylesheets

changes.title: Deprecated
items: Old icon assets — Moved to archive

versions.title: Perminov Studios v3
versions.description: Complete redesign of Perminov Studios with a new portfolio system, modern UI components, and enhanced user experience.

highlights.title: Portfolio Dashboard

highlights.title: Modal System
highlights.description: Modern modals with nested modal support
